propositions: Provider qualification must be decided by membership in a known-provider registry rather than regex shape testing to prevent typos in configured providers from being silently accepted until provider construction
Bedrock model IDs containing colons in version suffixes are incorrectly read as already provider-qualified by a shape-based colon prefix test, requiring replacement with membership validation

Configured provider names must be validated against the static set at config-resolution time and raise LLMConfigError with the invalid value and valid alternatives, while unknown inline prefixes in model strings must fail silently and be treated as unqualified

The static KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES frozenset must enumerate exactly the 24 provider names that pydantic-ai knows at runtime to prevent silent drift and must include slashed names like gateway/openai that are rejected by the current shape regex

Inline model string prefixes that do not match a known provider (such as the dotted Bedrock format or typos like bedrok) must not raise during split_provider_qualifier but instead return (None, model) to preserve unqualified model IDs intact
